podcast.title: Disappearance and Royalty Neglect (1996)
podcast.body: Hugh Lazarus, a musician who contributed music to various movies, including Jonathan Demme's films, largely disappeared in 1996 and failed to collect royalties for years, indicating the extent of her absence. "Hugh Lazarus is a musician who has contributed music to many different movies, including the films of Jonathan Demi. She pretty much disappeared in 1996 and didn't collect royalties for years. That's how far gone she was."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

podcast.title: Tracked Down Driving a Bus
podcast.body: Eventually, she was reportedly tracked down driving a bus on Staten Island. "Unless anyone heard, she had been tracked down driving a bus on Staten Island."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
